problem: Reflection repeats the same conclusion without testing assumptions.
correct_method: list assumptions
seek disconfirming evidence
revise only on new evidence
verification: A reflection pass must add evidence, invalidate an assumption, or terminate.

problem: A reflective pass alters facts already backed by authoritative evidence.
correct_method: freeze verified facts
reflect only on inference and strategy
verification: Authoritative facts retain provenance and value across reflection rounds.

problem: Repeated self-review consumes budget without changing decision quality.
correct_method: define convergence threshold
stop on no material delta
verification: Loop exits after bounded no-change rounds.

problem: Self-reflection reports confidence without independent verification.
correct_method: separate introspective critique from external verifier
verification: Terminal PASS still depends on independent evidence.

problem: Reasoning is reviewed against an obsolete problem state.
correct_method: check input revision before each reflection pass
verification: Reflection references current input hash/revision.

problem: The same internal evidence is repeatedly reused.
correct_method: require one disconfirming check per material assumption
verification: Material assumptions have explicit falsification attempts.

problem: Review depth is unrelated to task risk.
correct_method: scale reflection budget by uncertainty and impact
verification: Low-risk tasks terminate with smaller reflection budget.

problem: Two strategies alternate because no comparison criterion exists.
correct_method: define stable rubric and retain evidence deltas
verification: Strategy changes require measurable score/evidence improvement.

problem: Higher self-confidence is mistaken for correctness.
correct_method: treat confidence as metadata
require external verification
verification: Confidence never alone transitions a node to PASS.

problem: A deterministic schema validation is already conclusive.
correct_method: skip reflective loops when deterministic verifier fully resolves the question
verification: No unnecessary reflection is added after definitive deterministic evidence.

problem: A design has no catalog of credible failure modes.
correct_method: enumerate component, dependency, data, timing and human failures
verification: Critical components have at least one detection and recovery path.

problem: Known failure can occur silently.
correct_method: attach observable signal and threshold
verification: Failure condition is detectable before terminal certification.

problem: Failure handling can duplicate a committed action.
correct_method: require command idempotency and reconciliation
verification: Recovery cannot repeat a confirmed side effect.

problem: Redundant paths share the same hidden provider.
correct_method: map shared dependencies across alternatives
verification: Independence claim excludes shared critical dependencies.

problem: Resources are spent equally on trivial and catastrophic failures.
correct_method: score severity likelihood detectability and recovery cost
verification: Mitigation priority follows explicit risk score.

problem: No observability existed at the failing boundary.
correct_method: place checks at transition boundaries
verification: Failure becomes observable at or before propagation.

problem: Backoff and retry budget are absent.
correct_method: bound retries and apply backoff/circuit policy
verification: Failure cannot create an unbounded retry storm.

trigger: partial success reported as global success
problem: Failure domains are not separated.
correct_method: model component-level terminal states
verification: Global PASS requires all mandatory failure domains PASS.

problem: Failure analysis remains prose only.
correct_method: link each critical failure to detector, test and response
verification: Every critical failure has executable or observable evidence.

trigger: all theoretical failures must be mitigated
problem: Extremely implausible low-impact cases consume all engineering budget.
correct_method: prioritize material failures by explicit risk
verification: Deferred failures have documented low risk and rationale.

trigger: simulation uses observed labels as future facts
problem: The simulator leaks ground truth unavailable at decision time.
correct_method: freeze decision-time information set
verification: Simulation inputs contain only information available before the simulated decision.

problem: Scenario diversity is superficial.
correct_method: vary key uncertain assumptions independently
verification: Scenario set spans material uncertainty dimensions.

problem: Simulation result cannot be reproduced.
correct_method: record seed, model version and inputs
verification: Same seed/version/inputs reproduce the run within tolerance.

problem: Average score selects a strategy with unacceptable worst cases.
correct_method: track tail loss and hard safety constraints
verification: Strategy selection reports tail metrics and blocks forbidden outcomes.

problem: Calibration is never updated from observed outcomes.
correct_method: compare predictions with outcomes and recalibrate
verification: Calibration error is tracked over time.

problem: Exploration causes real side effects.
correct_method: isolate simulation in sandbox or pure world model
verification: Simulation cannot write production resources.

problem: World model assumes every external dependency remains healthy.
correct_method: inject dependency degradation and outage scenarios
verification: Critical dependency failure is represented in scenario coverage.

trigger: simulated evidence stored as observed evidence
problem: Prediction contaminates Source of Truth.
correct_method: tag evidence origin as simulated
verification: Observed and simulated evidence remain distinguishable in state.

problem: Runs continue after decision uncertainty is already low.
correct_method: stop on confidence/information-gain threshold
verification: Run count respects explicit budget and stopping condition.

problem: Results from different world models are compared as if identical.
correct_method: version simulator and invalidate incompatible comparisons
verification: Every run records simulator version and compatibility status.

problem: Repeated runs sample the same narrow world.
correct_method: diversify assumptions before increasing sample count
verification: Additional runs add scenario coverage, not only repetition.

trigger: biased world model repeats systematic error
problem: More Monte Carlo samples do not remove model bias.
correct_method: calibrate model and compare alternate simulators
verification: Bias is estimated separately from sampling variance.

trigger: missing tail metric selects fragile strategy
problem: Expected value masks rare catastrophic outcomes.
correct_method: include worst-case/CVaR or hard-loss gate
verification: Tail-risk threshold participates in decision scoring.

problem: World model starts from outdated state.
correct_method: fold latest authoritative observations before simulation
verification: Simulation base revision equals current reconciled state.

problem: Expensive strategy appears artificially superior.
correct_method: include latency, resource and rollback cost
verification: Utility score accounts for execution cost.

problem: Simulated success is recorded as completed execution.
correct_method: keep simulation and observation namespaces separate
verification: Only observed execution can satisfy runtime evidence gates.

trigger: more runs assumed to fix wrong model
problem: Sampling count is used to hide structural model error.
correct_method: validate model assumptions before increasing samples
verification: Model-fit checks precede sample-count expansion.

problem: Important scenario dispersion is hidden.
correct_method: report distribution, tail and confidence
verification: Decision report includes dispersion/tail metrics.

problem: Exact schema validation already has a definitive answer.
correct_method: use deterministic checks when the state transition is fully specified
verification: No simulator is invoked when exact validation suffices.

trigger: highest simulated utility may execute directly
problem: A simulated winner still lacks real-world permission.
correct_method: pass selected action through Policy Guard before execution
verification: Simulation cannot bypass permission or safety gates.
